inputs.prompt: Replace the blank gray canvas in <image1> with the following complete character image. Use the other images only as references, not as a collage. Render an opaque image. Photorealistic studio character reference. Exactly one person, plain neutral light gray background, soft even light, realistic skin and fabric. No text, no panels, no props unless part of the outfit. Entire body including head and both shoes, centered, 6 percent margin above and below, relaxed upright neutral stance, arms slightly away from torso, hands empty. Eye-level camera, natural long-lens perspective, no foreshortening. <image2> is the approved full-body character: preserve its identity, hairstyle, body proportions, complete clothing, colors, accessories and shoes. <image3> provides fine facial identity only. <image4> provides garment detail only; ignore the face of its wearer. Keep every garment piece on the same part of the body and do not mirror or duplicate patches. If the approved character wears a beret, keep the same fitted size, crown shape, tilt, side drape and narrow gap between its band and eyebrows when the head is rotated. The band stays snug on the head, not perched higher or pulled over the eyebrows. Keep the front insignia on the front of the beret. Do not redesign, add accessories, change age or change expression. Strict 90-degree left profile, nose pointing to the LEFT of the image, both shoulders aligned in profile. No three-quarter view. Match the head-to-foot size of <image2>. Avoid: multiple people, duplicate person, collage, text, watermark, cropped feet, cropped head, extra limbs, deformed hands, different clothes, different identity, fisheye.
